title: Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (unprefixed, pre-2025-07-30): one-property twin (context) (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context:host: the *.confluent.cloud broker in the logged config replaced by a self-hosted kafka-1.internal.example.test; the value is kept byte-for-byte (basis: context) and context:keyword: the confluent.cloud bootstrap host replaced by broker.internal.example.test, so no confluent keyword remains; the value is kept byte-for-byte (basis: context). Twin of "Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (unprefixed, pre-2025-07-30): must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
